sonnet.problem: The two wrong answers, Rage and Hatred, come straight from the acts-of-the-flesh list that card 8 just told. Card 11 and the question itself ('Paul sets the fruit of the Spirit right against that list') say the fruit is the opposite of that list. A baker can rule out both wrong answers from the setup without reasoning about the fruit.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
